genesis.49.p1.b1.text: Then Jacob called for his sons

genesis.49.p1.b2.text: Gather around so that I can tell you what will happen to you in the days to come: … listen to your father Israel.

genesis.49.p1.b3.text: Reuben, you are my firstborn, … excelling in honor, excelling in power.

genesis.49.p1.b4.text: Uncontrolled as the waters, you will no longer excel,

genesis.49.p2.b1.text: Simeon and Levi are brothers; their swords are weapons of violence.

genesis.49.p2.b2.text: May I never enter their council; may I never join their assembly.

genesis.49.p2.b3.text: Cursed be their anger, for it is strong, and their wrath, for it is cruel!

genesis.49.p3.b1.text: Judah, your brothers shall praise you. … your father’s sons shall bow down to you.

genesis.49.p3.b2.text: Judah is a young lion— … Like a lion he crouches and lies down; like a lioness, who dares to rouse him?

genesis.49.p3.b3.text: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the staff from between his feet, until Shiloh comes and the allegiance of the nations is his.

genesis.49.p4.b1.text: Zebulun shall dwell by the seashore and become a harbor for ships; his border shall extend to Sidon.

genesis.49.p4.b2.text: Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the sheepfolds. … so he bent his shoulder to the burden and submitted to labor as a servant.

genesis.49.p4.b3.text: He will be a snake by the road, a viper in the path that bites the horse’s heels so that its rider tumbles backward.

genesis.49.p4.b4.text: I await Your salvation, O LORD.

genesis.49.p5.b1.text: Gad will be attacked by raiders, but he will attack their heels.

genesis.49.p5.b2.text: Asher’s food will be rich; he shall provide royal delicacies.

genesis.49.p5.b3.text: Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns.

genesis.49.p6.b1.text: Joseph is a fruitful vine— a fruitful vine by a spring, whose branches scale the wall.

genesis.49.p6.b2.text: The archers attacked him with bitterness; they aimed at him in hostility. Yet he steadied his bow, and his strong arms were tempered by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob,

genesis.49.p6.b3.text: May they rest on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the prince of his brothers.

genesis.49.p6.b4.text: Benjamin is a ravenous wolf; in the morning he devours the prey, in the evening he divides the plunder.”

genesis.49.p7.b1.text: I am about to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite. …

genesis.49.p7.b2.text: There Abraham and his wife Sarah are buried, there Isaac and his wife Rebekah are buried, and there I buried Leah.

genesis.49.p7.b3.text: When Jacob had finished instructing his sons, he pulled his feet into the bed

genesis.49.p7.b4.text: and breathed his last, and he was gathered to his people.
